title: How a change reaches main (CI, E2E, review, merge)
caption: .github/workflows/ci.yml and e2e.yml; ADR-0020 and ADR-0028. Agents never edit the workflows to get their own change through.

steps.title: Task branch
steps.body: One task = one branch `task/<ID>-<slug>`; the wave integrator squash-merges task branches into the integration branch.
steps.expect: Each task commit keeps its `Task:` footer.

steps.title: CI on the pull request
steps.body: Jobs: plan-lint, deploy-files, systemd-units, check-vm (VM check test), dev-setup, build-test, integration, alt-hosts, sdk-node22 (not required).
steps.expect: Required checks green; deploy-files proves the Caddy build SHA-256, the Caddyfile smoke test and the deploy/healthcheck/log tests.

steps.title: E2E when needed
steps.body: Add the `e2e` label (or run E2E on demand); nightly at 02:23 UTC.
steps.expect: Projects portal, platform-admin, storefront, ota-admin pass; on failure artefact `e2e-<run id>-<attempt>`.

steps.title: Merge to main
steps.body: A wave reaches main as one pull request merged with a merge commit; a single task's PR is squash-merged.

steps.title: Deploy
steps.body: Run Deploy from `main`; it calls E2E for the same commit before anything reaches the VM.
steps.expect: No way to deploy past a red e2e job.
